adjacent_not_subsumed.distinction: Freshness Train classifies PR/master requalification; C3-12 computes affected live coordination lanes from explicit dependencies.

purpose: Compute bounded targeted invalidation over explicit shared-current Message Board, Party, Cohesion, Git-path, and labeled caller-supplied dependency edges; return affected live lanes and required recheck obligations without performing refresh or mutation.

graph_semantics.seed_edges: CHANGE_* edges bind the supplied change to an explicit coordinate and do not count as semantic propagation depth
graph_semantics.direct: one observed semantic edge from the changed coordinate to a live agent lane
graph_semantics.transitive: more than one observed semantic edge; every path preserves relation/evidence/standing provenance
graph_semantics.party_membership: recorded for impact context but non-propagating by itself
graph_semantics.party_goal: goal_ref -> specifically assigned member may propagate
graph_semantics.provider_consumer: provider agent -> provides(ref) -> NEED dependency(ref) -> need owner
graph_semantics.message: message event -> explicit recipient; Party message pending ACK may require ACK_MESSAGE
graph_semantics.bounds: max_depth 1..8 plus internal path-count fail-safe; cutoff yields unresolved residue

git_semantics.git_range: resolve base/head to exact commits and compute changed_paths read-only
git_semantics.caller_changed_paths_mismatch: observed git diff wins and mismatch is returned in unresolved
git_semantics.path_hit: changed path affects a lane only through exact target/dependency/caller-supplied edge
git_semantics.invalid_ref: GIT_REF_HOLD with unresolved GIT_REF_UNAVAILABLE; never empty-diff fabrication

message_ack_semantics.party_v2_v3_message: explicit recipient with no observed ACK => READ_MESSAGE + ACK_MESSAGE
message_ack_semantics.observed_ack: removes ACK_MESSAGE requirement but does not erase the message impact path

party_semantics.membership: context only; does not fan out impact

unknowns.max_depth: truncation yields MAX_DEPTH_OR_PATH_LIMIT_REACHED and unresolved cutoff nodes
unknowns.decision_runtime: DECISION_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE; DECISION edges are caller-supplied only

mata_boundary.law: OBSERVED_RUNTIME_EDGE != MATA_CANONICAL_DEPENDENCY; never fabricate OID/VID/SAME-WORK/SAME-BASE or canonical assignment dependency from prose

successor: After merge, rehydrate Cohesion P0 and current claims before selecting C3-13 conflict resolution; dependency cone becomes an evidence input, never an automatic conflict treatment engine.
